title: soroseris hookeriana subsp. occidentalis
intro: Soroseris hookeriana subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Soroseris, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Soroseris hookeriana subsp. occidentalis include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
